summary: ODAYA end-to-end testing complete. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass against public URL (/api/health returns groq_configured:true, /api/chat validates empty/missing/long messages with 422, /api/chat happy-path with Groq openai/gpt-oss-20b returns non-empty replies within ~1-3s, /api/ root ok). Frontend: Home renders ODAYA brand, 6 feature tiles, 'Search trains' CTA and Assistant FAB; all 6 tiles + FAB navigate to the correct screens. Train Search (Mumbai -> New Delhi) returns matching cards and card tap opens Train Detail. PNR Status (4521098763) returns a correct CONFIRMED sample card with coach/seat/status. Live Status: 8 train chips, delay banner, current/next stations, progress bar and refresh work. Seat Availability: 8 train chips, 3 class chips, 5-day availability rows render with AVL/RAC/WL tags. Fare Calculator: 1200/4 => Rs.300.00, quick-people 3 => Rs.400.00, reset clears inputs. Train Route: 8 chips, 7-stop timeline with arr/dep/halt/day and current-node highlight. Assistant: 5 suggestion chips in empty state; both suggestion-tap and typed-input + send button produce user+assistant bubbles with Groq replies. No critical or blocking issues found.

issues: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow' (shows up on Home FAB and other elevated surfaces). Non-blocking but should be migrated for RN 0.76+/web parity.

action_items: (Optional) Replace deprecated 'shadow*' style props with 'boxShadow' / platform-appropriate elevation to silence react-native-web deprecation warning (e.g. FAB in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py instantiates AsyncGroq(client) per request; consider a module-level singleton to avoid repeated client construction overhead.
server.py logs chat via db.chat_logs.insert_one but never returns MongoDB _id to clients - good, no ObjectId leakage risk.

Pressable 'disabled' prop in react-native-web sets aria-disabled rather than DOM 'disabled'; test suites should prefer attribute checks (e.g. aria-disabled='true') over Playwright is_disabled() for RN components. This is a note for future testing agents, not a product bug.
seed_data_creation: None - railway data is in-app demo; chat_logs may have a few TEST_ entries created by Groq tests (safe to leave).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has only /api/health and /api/chat (Groq openai/gpt-oss-20b). Public URL: https://odaya-mobile.preview.emergentagent.com. Correct frontend testIDs: Seat Avail uses avail-train-chip-<num>, avail-class-chip-<cls>, avail-row-<idx>. Fare Calc uses fare-input, people-input, quick-people-<n>, per-person-value, fare-reset-button. Train Route uses route-train-chip-<num>, route-stop-<idx>. Assistant uses suggestion-<idx>, assistant-input, assistant-send-button, user-bubble, assistant-bubble. PNR uses pnr-input, pnr-check-button, pnr-result-card. For RN-web Pressable disabled checks, read aria-disabled attribute instead of Playwright is_disabled(). Mobile viewport 390x844 used.
rca_of_issue: N/A - all flows pass. First-pass Playwright script used wrong testIDs for seat/fare/route and incorrect disabled-detection for Pressable; corrected in second pass and all assertions passed.
